subject: Algorithms
question_en: Why does Dijkstra's algorithm fail when a graph contains negative edge weights?
question_hi: डाइक्स्ट्रा का एल्गोरिदम ऋणात्मक किनारों (negative edge weights) वाले ग्राफ पर क्यों विफल हो जाता है?
gold_answer: Dijkstra's greedy choice assumes that once a vertex is extracted its distance is finalized; negative edges violate this optimal substructure invariant.
notes: Negative edge weights violate greedy invariant

subject: Algorithms
question_en: What algorithm should be used to find single-source shortest paths in graphs with negative weights?
question_hi: ऋणात्मक भार वाले ग्राफ में सिंगल-सोर्स सबसे छोटा रास्ता खोजने के लिए किस एल्गोरिदम का उपयोग किया जाना चाहिए?
gold_answer: The Bellman-Ford algorithm must be used; it runs in O(V*E) time and detects negative weight cycles.

subject: Algorithms
question_en: What is the time complexity of Dijkstra's algorithm with a binary min-heap?
question_hi: बाइनरी मिन-हीप का उपयोग करके डाइक्स्ट्रा के एल्गोरिदम की समय जटिलता (time complexity) क्या है?
gold_answer: O((V + E) log V) where V is the number of vertices and E is the number of edges.

subject: Algorithms
question_en: What are the two core properties required for dynamic programming to apply to an optimization problem?
question_hi: डायनामिक प्रोग्रामिंग को लागू करने के लिए आवश्यक दो मुख्य गुण कौन से हैं?
gold_answer: Optimal substructure and overlapping subproblems.

subject: Algorithms
question_en: How does Merge Sort compare with Quick Sort in terms of worst-case time complexity and memory overhead?
question_hi: वर्स्ट-केस समय जटिलता और मेमोरी ओवरहेड के मामले में मर्ज सॉर्ट और क्विक सॉर्ट की तुलना कैसे की जाती है?
gold_answer: Merge Sort guarantees O(n log n) worst-case time but requires O(n) auxiliary space; Quick Sort has an O(n^2) worst-case time but runs in-place with O(log n) stack memory.
notes: Merge Sort vs Quick Sort space-time tradeoff

subject: Algorithms
question_en: Explain how Kruskal's algorithm constructs a Minimum Spanning Tree and what data structure enables its efficiency.
question_hi: बताइए कि क्रुस्कल का एल्गोरिदम कैसे मिनिमम स्पैनिंग ट्री (MST) बनाता है और कौन सा डेटा स्ट्रक्चर इसकी दक्षता बढ़ाता है?
gold_answer: Kruskal's algorithm sorts all edges by weight and greedily inserts them unless they form a cycle, using the Disjoint Set Union (Union-Find) data structure.

subject: Algorithms
question_en: Compare Prim's algorithm with Kruskal's algorithm for dense versus sparse graphs.
question_hi: घने (dense) बनाम विरल (sparse) ग्राफ के लिए प्रिम के एल्गोरिदम की क्रुस्कल के एल्गोरिदम से तुलना करें।
gold_answer: Prim's algorithm with an adjacency matrix or Fibonacci heap is preferred for dense graphs (E ~ V^2), whereas Kruskal's algorithm is superior for sparse graphs (E ~ V).

subject: Algorithms
question_en: What is the Master Theorem and under what conditions can it be applied to divide-and-conquer recurrences?
question_hi: मास्टर प्रमेय (Master Theorem) क्या है और इसे डिवाइड-एंड-कॉनकर पुनरावृत्तियों पर किन शर्तों के तहत लागू किया जा सकता है?
gold_answer: The Master Theorem solves recurrences of the form T(n) = a*T(n/b) + f(n), where a >= 1 and b > 1, comparing f(n) with n^(log_b a).

subject: Algorithms
question_en: Given a directed acyclic graph (DAG), explain step-by-step how topological sorting facilitates computing single-source shortest paths in linear time.
question_hi: एक निर्देशित अचक्रीय ग्राफ (DAG) में, चरणबद्ध तरीके से समझाइए कि टोपोलॉजिकल सॉर्टिंग कैसे रैखिक समय में सिंगल-सोर्स सबसे छोटे रास्ते की गणना करती है।
gold_answer: First, topologically sort the DAG vertices in O(V+E) time using DFS or Kahn's algorithm; then relax outgoing edges in topological order, guaranteeing each vertex is visited only after all its predecessors have finalized.
notes: DAG shortest path via topological sort

subject: Algorithms
question_en: What is the difference between memoization (top-down) and tabulation (bottom-up) in dynamic programming?
question_hi: डायनामिक प्रोग्रामिंग में मेमोइज़ेशन (टॉप-डाउन) और सारणीकरण (बॉटम-अप) के बीच क्या अंतर है?
gold_answer: Memoization solves subproblems recursively on demand and caches results in a lookup table; tabulation systematically fills an iterative DP table starting from base cases.

subject: Algorithms
question_en: Describe the 0/1 Knapsack recurrence relation and its time-space complexity.
question_hi: 0/1 नैपसैक पुनरावृत्ति संबंध (recurrence relation) और इसकी समय-स्थान जटिलता का वर्णन करें।
gold_answer: DP[i][w] = max(DP[i-1][w], DP[i-1][w - weight[i]] + value[i]); running in O(n*W) pseudo-polynomial time and O(n*W) or O(W) space.

subject: Algorithms
question_en: Why can the Fractional Knapsack problem be solved with a greedy algorithm while 0/1 Knapsack requires dynamic programming?
question_hi: फ्रैक्शनल नैपसैक समस्या को लालची (Greedy) एल्गोरिदम से क्यों हल किया जा सकता है जबकि 0/1 नैपसैक के लिए डायनामिक प्रोग्रामिंग की आवश्यकता होती है?
gold_answer: Fractional knapsack exhibits the greedy-choice property because taking fractions of items by highest value-to-weight ratio never precludes optimal packing, whereas 0/1 knapsack items cannot be split.
notes: Greedy choice in Fractional vs 0/1 Knapsack

subject: Algorithms
question_en: What is an AVL tree and what is its balance factor invariant?
question_hi: AVL ट्री क्या है और इसका संतुलन कारक अपरिवर्तनीय (balance factor invariant) क्या है?
gold_answer: An AVL tree is a self-balancing binary search tree where the height difference (balance factor) between left and right subtrees of every node is at most 1 (-1, 0, or +1).

subject: Algorithms
question_en: How do tree rotations (Left-Left, Right-Right, Left-Right, Right-Left) restore balance in an AVL tree?
question_hi: ट्री रोटेशन (LL, RR, LR, RL) एक AVL ट्री में संतुलन कैसे बहाल करते हैं?
gold_answer: Single rotations (LL, RR) fix single-direction imbalances; double rotations (LR, RL) first rotate the child to align the imbalance and then rotate the parent to restore O(log n) height balance.

subject: Algorithms
question_en: Trace how the Floyd-Warshall algorithm computes all-pairs shortest paths through intermediate vertices k = 1 to V.
question_hi: बताइए कि कैसे फ़्लॉइड-वॉर्शेल एल्गोरिदम मध्यवर्ती शीर्षों k = 1 से V के माध्यम से सभी जोड़ियों के सबसे छोटे रास्तों (all-pairs shortest paths) की गणना करता है।
gold_answer: It updates d[i][j] = min(d[i][j], d[i][k] + d[k][j]) through V nested iterations, iteratively considering whether routing through vertex k provides a shorter path between every pair (i, j).

subject: Algorithms
question_en: What is the difference between BFS and DFS in graph traversal regarding frontier data structures and shortest-path properties?
question_hi: फ्रंटियर डेटा संरचनाओं और सबसे छोटे रास्ते के गुणों के संबंध में ग्राफ ट्रैवर्सल में BFS और DFS के बीच क्या अंतर है?
gold_answer: BFS uses a FIFO queue and finds the shortest path in unweighted graphs; DFS uses a LIFO stack (or recursion) and explores deep branches before backtracking without guaranteeing shortest paths.
notes: BFS vs DFS queue vs stack

subject: Algorithms
question_en: What is amortized analysis and what are the three standard methods to perform it?
question_hi: परिशोधित विश्लेषण (Amortized Analysis) क्या है और इसे निष्पादित करने के तीन मानक तरीके कौन से हैं?
gold_answer: Amortized analysis averages the running time per operation over a worst-case sequence of operations; the three standard methods are Aggregate Analysis, Accounting Method, and Potential Method.

subject: Algorithms
question_en: Explain the mechanics of the Huffman Coding greedy algorithm to generate an optimal prefix-free code.
question_hi: इष्टतम प्रीफिक्स-मुक्त कोड उत्पन्न करने के लिए हफ़मैन कोडिंग (Huffman Coding) के लालची एल्गोरिदम की कार्यप्रणाली समझाइए।
gold_answer: Huffman builds a binary tree bottom-up by repeatedly extracting the two lowest-frequency nodes from a min-heap, merging them into an internal node whose weight is their sum, and reinserting it until one tree remains.

subject: Algorithms
question_en: Explain how the Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) problem constructs its 2D DP matrix and backtracks to extract the sequence.
question_hi: समझाइए कि लांगेस्ट कॉमन सबसीक्वेंस (LCS) समस्या कैसे अपना 2D DP मैट्रिक्स बनाती है और अनुक्रम निकालने के लिए बैकट्रैक करती है।
gold_answer: If characters match, c[i][j] = c[i-1][j-1] + 1; otherwise c[i][j] = max(c[i-1][j], c[i][j-1]). Backtracking begins at (m, n), stepping diagonally when characters matched and following the greater adjacent entry otherwise.

subject: Algorithms
question_en: Why is comparison-based sorting lower-bounded by Omega(n log n) in the worst case?
question_hi: वर्स्ट केस में तुलना-आधारित सॉर्टिंग की निचली सीमा (lower bound) Omega(n log n) क्यों होती है?
gold_answer: Any comparison sort corresponds to a decision tree with n! leaves. A binary tree with n! leaves must have a height of at least log2(n!) = Omega(n log n) comparisons.
notes: Decision tree lower bound on sorting

subject: Algorithms
question_en: How does Counting Sort achieve linear O(n + k) time, and why does this not violate the Omega(n log n) lower bound?
question_hi: काउंटिंग सॉर्ट (Counting Sort) रैखिक O(n + k) समय कैसे प्राप्त करता है, और यह Omega(n log n) की निचली सीमा का उल्लंघन क्यों नहीं करता?
gold_answer: Counting Sort is non-comparison based; it counts occurrences of integer keys directly into an auxiliary array, bypassing the decision tree comparison lower bound.

subject: Algorithms
question_en: How do shortest-path graph algorithms like Dijkstra link graph traversal theory with operational network routing protocols?
question_hi: डाइक्स्ट्रा जैसे सबसे छोटे रास्ते के ग्राफ एल्गोरिदम कैसे ग्राफ ट्रैवर्सल सिद्धांत को परिचालन नेटवर्क रूटिंग प्रोटोकॉल से जोड़ते हैं?
gold_answer: Graph shortest-path algorithms form the foundational algorithmic engine of link-state network protocols like OSPF, mapping network routers to vertices and latency/metrics to edge weights.

subject: Algorithms
question_en: What is the exact asymptotic runtime of quantum Grover search on a classical Von Neumann processor?
question_hi: पारंपरिक वॉन न्यूमैन प्रोसेसर पर क्वांटम ग्रोवर खोज (Grover Search) का सटीक स्पर्शोन्मुख रनटाइम क्या है?
gold_answer: Unanswerable from reference corpus: Grover's search requires quantum superposition registers and does not run on classical Von Neumann hardware.
notes: Unanswerable: Grover search is a quantum algorithm

subject: Algorithms
question_en: What polynomial-time algorithm solves the Traveling Salesperson Problem on general graphs without heuristics?
question_hi: बिना ह्यूरिस्टिक्स के सामान्य ग्राफ पर ट्रैवलिंग सेल्सपर्सन समस्या (TSP) को कौन सा बहुपद-समय (polynomial-time) एल्गोरिदम हल करता है?
gold_answer: Unanswerable: TSP is an NP-hard problem; no polynomial-time algorithm is known unless P = NP.

subject: Automata
question_en: What are the five components in the formal definition of a Deterministic Finite Automaton (DFA)?
question_hi: एक नियतात्मक परिमित ऑटोमेटन (DFA) की औपचारिक परिभाषा में पांच घटक कौन से हैं?
gold_answer: A 5-tuple: Q (states), Sigma (alphabet), delta (transition function), q_0 (start state), and F (accept states).

subject: Automata
question_en: Does an NFA have more computational power than a DFA?
question_hi: क्या NFA के पास DFA की तुलना में अधिक कम्प्यूटेशनल शक्ति होती है?
gold_answer: No. By the subset construction algorithm, any NFA can be converted to an equivalent DFA with at most 2^n states.

subject: Automata
question_en: What kind of storage does a Pushdown Automaton use?
question_hi: पुशडाउन ऑटोमेटन (PDA) किस प्रकार के स्टोरेज का उपयोग करता है?
gold_answer: An unbounded Last-In-First-Out (LIFO) stack storage.

subject: Automata
question_en: Why is the Halting Problem undecidable on Turing machines?
question_hi: ट्यूरिंग मशीनों पर हाल्टिंग समस्या (Halting Problem) अनिर्णीत (undecidable) क्यों है?
gold_answer: Because any hypothetical decider can be contradicted using a diagonal self-referential construction yielding a logical contradiction.

subject: Automata
question_en: Compare Deterministic Pushdown Automata (DPDA) with Non-deterministic Pushdown Automata (NPDA) in computational power.
question_hi: कम्प्यूटेशनल शक्ति में डिटर्मिनिस्टिक पुशडाउन ऑटोमेटा (DPDA) और नॉन-डिटर्मिनिस्टिक पुशडाउन ऑटोमेटा (NPDA) की तुलना करें।
gold_answer: NPDAs are strictly more powerful than DPDAs; NPDAs accept all context-free languages, whereas DPDAs accept only deterministic context-free languages.

subject: Automata
question_en: How does the subset construction (powerset construction) convert an NFA into an equivalent DFA?
question_hi: सबसेट कंस्ट्रक्शन (पावरसेट कंस्ट्रक्शन) एक NFA को समकक्ष DFA में कैसे बदलता है?
gold_answer: Each state of the equivalent DFA represents a subset of states of the NFA, tracking epsilon-closures and transition sets across all possible non-deterministic branches.

subject: Automata
question_en: What is the Pumping Lemma for Regular Languages and how is it used to prove a language is non-regular?
question_hi: रेगुलर भाषाओं के लिए पंपिंग लेम्मा (Pumping Lemma) क्या है और इसका उपयोग किसी भाषा के गैर-नियमित होने को सिद्ध करने के लिए कैसे किया जाता है?
gold_answer: It states that any sufficiently long string s in a regular language can be partitioned into xyz with |xy| <= p and |y| > 0 such that xy^i z is in L for all i >= 0. Proof by contradiction assumes regular and violates pumping.

subject: Automata
question_en: What is the Chomsky Hierarchy and what are its four formal grammar levels?
question_hi: चॉम्स्की पदानुक्रम (Chomsky Hierarchy) क्या है और इसके चार औपचारिक व्याकरण स्तर कौन से हैं?
gold_answer: Type 0 (Unrestricted / Turing Machines), Type 1 (Context-Sensitive / Linear Bounded Automata), Type 2 (Context-Free / Pushdown Automata), and Type 3 (Regular / Finite Automata).

subject: Automata
question_en: Prove that the language L = {a^n b^n | n >= 0} is not regular using the Pumping Lemma.
question_hi: पंपिंग लेम्मा का उपयोग करके सिद्ध कीजिए कि भाषा L = {a^n b^n | n >= 0} नियमित (regular) नहीं है।
gold_answer: Assume L is regular with pumping length p. Choose s = a^p b^p. Since |xy| <= p, y consists entirely of 'a's. Pumping y^0 or y^2 yields strings with unequal counts of a's and b's, contradicting membership in L.
notes: Pumping lemma proof for a^n b^n

subject: Automata
question_en: Describe the steps of Chomsky Normal Form (CNF) conversion for context-free grammars.
question_hi: कॉन्टेक्स्ट-फ्री ग्रामर के लिए चॉम्स्की नॉर्मल फॉर्म (CNF) रूपांतरण के चरणों का वर्णन करें।
gold_answer: 1. Create new start symbol S_0 -> S. 2. Eliminate epsilon-productions (A -> epsilon). 3. Eliminate unit productions (A -> B). 4. Restructure rules into A -> BC or A -> a.

subject: Automata
question_en: What is the difference between Decidable (Recursive) and Recognizable (Recursively Enumerable) languages?
question_hi: निर्णायक (Decidable/Recursive) और पहचानने योग्य (Recognizable/RE) भाषाओं के बीच क्या अंतर है?
gold_answer: A decidable language has a Turing machine that halts on all inputs (accepts or rejects); a recognizable language has a Turing machine that accepts valid strings but may loop infinitely on invalid inputs.

subject: Automata
question_en: What does Rice's Theorem state regarding semantic properties of Turing machines?
question_hi: ट्यूरिंग मशीनों के सिमेंटिक गुणों के संबंध में राइस का प्रमेय (Rice's Theorem) क्या कहता है?
gold_answer: Rice's Theorem states that any non-trivial semantic property of the language recognized by a Turing machine is undecidable.

subject: Automata
question_en: What is a 7-tuple formal definition of a standard single-tape Turing Machine?
question_hi: एक मानक सिंगल-टेप ट्यूरिंग मशीन की 7-टुपल औपचारिक परिभाषा क्या है?
gold_answer: (Q, Sigma, Gamma, delta, q_0, q_accept, q_reject) where Gamma is tape alphabet including blank symbol.

subject: Automata
question_en: Compare Mealy Machines and Moore Machines in finite state transducer theory.
question_hi: परिमित अवस्था ट्रांसड्यूसर सिद्धांत में मीली मशीनों (Mealy) और मूर मशीनों (Moore) की तुलना करें।
gold_answer: In Moore machines, outputs depend solely on the current state; in Mealy machines, outputs depend on both the current state and the current input symbol.
notes: Mealy vs Moore state-input output dependency

subject: Automata
question_en: How does the CYK (Cocke-Younger-Kasami) algorithm determine if a string belongs to a Context-Free Grammar?
question_hi: CYK एल्गोरिदम कैसे निर्धारित करता है कि कोई स्ट्रिंग कॉन्टेक्स्ट-फ्री ग्रामर (CFG) से संबंधित है या नहीं?
gold_answer: Using dynamic programming on a grammar in Chomsky Normal Form, it builds a triangular table of substrings of increasing length, running in O(n^3 * |G|) time.

subject: Automata
question_en: What is the Church-Turing thesis and why is it considered a thesis rather than a mathematical theorem?
question_hi: चर्च-ट्यूरिंग थीसिस (Church-Turing thesis) क्या है और इसे गणितीय प्रमेय के बजाय एक थीसिस क्यों माना जाता है?
gold_answer: It asserts that any effectively calculable function can be computed by a Turing machine; it is a thesis because 'effective calculability' is an intuitive notion rather than a formal mathematical definition.

subject: Automata
question_en: How does the reduction technique prove that the Post Correspondence Problem (PCP) is undecidable?
question_hi: रिडक्शन तकनीक (Reduction) कैसे सिद्ध करती है कि पोस्ट कॉरेस्पॉन्डेंस समस्या (PCP) अनिर्णीत है?
gold_answer: By reducing the Halting Problem (or acceptance problem A_TM) to PCP: simulating the computation history of a Turing machine as domino tiles such that a match exists if and only if the TM accepts.
notes: PCP undecidability via TM computation history reduction

subject: Automata
question_en: Under what closure operations are Regular Languages closed?
question_hi: रेगुलर भाषाएं किन क्लोज़र ऑपरेशनों के तहत बंद (closed) होती हैं?
gold_answer: Union, Intersection, Complement, Concatenation, and Kleene Star.

subject: Automata
question_en: Compare the closure properties of Context-Free Languages with Regular Languages regarding Intersection and Complement.
question_hi: इंटरसेक्शन और कॉम्प्लिमेंट के संबंध में कॉन्टेक्स्ट-फ्री भाषाओं के क्लोज़र गुणों की रेगुलर भाषाओं से तुलना करें।
gold_answer: Regular languages are closed under both intersection and complement; context-free languages are NOT closed under intersection or complement.
notes: CFL non-closure under intersection and complement

subject: Automata
question_en: Describe DFA minimization using the table-filling (Myhill-Nerode / equivalence theorem) algorithm.
question_hi: टेबल-फिलिंग (Myhill-Nerode) एल्गोरिदम का उपयोग करके DFA न्यूनीकरण (minimization) का वर्णन करें।
gold_answer: Construct a lower-triangular table of pairs (p, q). Mark pairs where one is accept and the other is reject; iteratively mark unmarked pairs if transitions on any input lead to an already marked pair. Merge unmarked equivalents.

subject: Automata
question_en: What is an ambiguous context-free grammar and what is inherent ambiguity?
question_hi: अस्पष्ट कॉन्टेक्स्ट-फ्री ग्रामर (Ambiguous CFG) क्या है और अंतर्निहित अस्पष्टता (inherent ambiguity) क्या है?
gold_answer: A CFG is ambiguous if some string has two or more distinct parse trees (or leftmost derivations). A language is inherently ambiguous if every CFG generating it is ambiguous.
notes: Grammar ambiguity vs inherent language ambiguity

subject: Automata
question_en: How does finite state machine theory inform the TCP connection lifecycle state diagram?
question_hi: परिमित अवस्था मशीन (FSM) सिद्धांत टीसीपी कनेक्शन जीवनचक्र अवस्था आरेख को कैसे संरचित करता है?
gold_answer: TCP connection establishment and teardown are modeled as a formal Finite State Machine (LISTEN, SYN_SENT, ESTABLISHED, FIN_WAIT), where packet arrivals trigger deterministic state transitions.
notes: FSM connection to TCP state machine

subject: Automata
question_en: What general algorithm decides whether two arbitrary Context-Free Grammars generate the exact same language?
question_hi: कौन सा सामान्य एल्गोरिदम यह तय करता है कि क्या दो मनमाने कॉन्टेक्स्ट-फ्री ग्रामर बिल्कुल समान भाषा उत्पन्न करते हैं?
gold_answer: Unanswerable: The equivalence problem for context-free grammars (L(G1) == L(G2)) is undecidable.
notes: Unanswerable: Equivalence of CFGs is undecidable

subject: Automata
question_en: What is the mechanical solution to the halting problem on hypercomputers with infinite time tape?
question_hi: अनंत समय टेप वाले हाइपरकंप्यूटरों पर हाल्टिंग समस्या का यांत्रिक समाधान क्या है?
gold_answer: Unanswerable from reference corpus: Hypercomputational models with transfinite ordinal timesteps are speculative mathematical constructs not realized in standard automata theory.

subject: DBMS
question_en: What do the ACID properties stand for in transaction processing?
question_hi: ट्रांजेक्शन प्रोसेसिंग में ACID संपत्तियों (properties) का पूरा अर्थ क्या है?
gold_answer: Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, and Durability.

subject: DBMS
question_en: How does strict Two-Phase Locking (2PL) prevent cascading rollbacks?
question_hi: सख्त 2PL (Strict Two-Phase Locking) कैस्केडिंग रोलबैक को कैसे रोकता है?
gold_answer: By holding all exclusive locks until the transaction commits or aborts.

subject: DBMS
question_en: What is the primary difference between 3NF and BCNF?
question_hi: 3NF और BCNF के बीच प्राथमिक अंतर क्या है?
gold_answer: In BCNF, for every functional dependency X -> A, X must be a superkey, whereas 3NF allows A to be a prime attribute.

subject: DBMS
question_en: Compare B-Trees with B+ Trees in relational database index architectures.
question_hi: रिलेशनल डेटाबेस इंडेक्स आर्किटेक्चर में B-ट्री की B+ ट्री से तुलना करें।
gold_answer: In B-Trees, data pointers are stored in both internal and leaf nodes; in B+ Trees, all actual data records/pointers reside only in leaf nodes connected by a linked list, optimizing range scans and caching.
notes: B-Tree vs B+ Tree leaf pointer difference

subject: DBMS
question_en: What are the four ANSI SQL transaction isolation levels and what anomalies do they prevent?
question_hi: चार ANSI SQL ट्रांजेक्शन अलगाव स्तर (Isolation Levels) कौन से हैं और वे किन विसंगतियों को रोकते हैं?
gold_answer: Read Uncommitted, Read Committed (prevents dirty reads), Repeatable Read (prevents non-repeatable reads), and Serializable (prevents phantom reads).

subject: DBMS
question_en: Explain the Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) protocol and the STEAL/NO-FORCE buffer management policy.
question_hi: राइट-अहेड लॉगिंग (WAL) प्रोटोकॉल और STEAL/NO-FORCE बफर प्रबंधन नीति को समझाइए।
gold_answer: WAL mandates that log records must be flushed to non-volatile storage before corresponding dirty database pages are written. STEAL permits uncommitted pages to overwrite disk frames; NO-FORCE allows committed transactions without immediate disk flush.

subject: DBMS
question_en: Trace how the ARIES recovery algorithm operates through Analysis, Redo, and Undo passes after a crash.
question_hi: बताइए कि ARIES रिकवरी एल्गोरिदम क्रैश के बाद एनालिसिस, रीडो और अनडू चरणों के माध्यम से कैसे काम करता है।
gold_answer: Analysis identifies dirty pages and active transactions at the checkpoint; Redo reapplies all logged actions from the earliest unwritten log sequence number (repeating history); Undo rolls back active uncommitted transactions in reverse order.

subject: DBMS
question_en: Compare Clustered Indexes with Non-Clustered (Secondary) Indexes in physical database design.
question_hi: भौतिक डेटाबेस डिज़ाइन में क्लस्टर इंडेक्स और नॉन-क्लस्टर (सेकेंडरी) इंडेक्स की तुलना करें।
gold_answer: A clustered index dictates the physical sorting order of table rows on disk (only one per table); non-clustered indexes maintain separate B+ tree structures storing pointers back to the clustered key or row locator.

subject: DBMS
question_en: Describe how to test if a transaction schedule is Conflict Serializable using a Precedence (Serialization) Graph.
question_hi: वर्णन करें कि प्रेसिडेंस (सीरियलाइज़ेशन) ग्राफ का उपयोग करके यह कैसे जांचा जाए कि कोई ट्रांजेक्शन शेड्यूल कॉन्फ्लिक्ट सीरियलाइज़ेबल है या नहीं।
gold_answer: Draw directed edges from Ti to Tj if Ti accesses a shared data item before Tj and at least one operation is a write. If and only if the graph contains no directed cycles, the schedule is conflict serializable.

subject: DBMS
question_en: What is the difference between lossless-join decomposition and dependency preservation in relational normalization?
question_hi: रिलेशनल नॉर्मलाइज़ेशन में लॉसलेस-जॉइन डीकंपोज़िशन और डिपेंडेंसी प्रिजर्वेशन के बीच क्या अंतर है?
gold_answer: Lossless join ensures natural join of decomposed relations reconstructs original tuples without spurious data; dependency preservation ensures all functional dependencies can be verified on individual relations without joins.

subject: DBMS
question_en: What are the rules of Armstrong's Axioms for functional dependencies?
question_hi: कार्यात्मक निर्भरताओं (Functional Dependencies) के लिए आर्मस्ट्रांग के स्वयंसिद्ध (Armstrong's Axioms) नियम क्या हैं?
gold_answer: Reflexivity (if Y subset X, then X -> Y), Augmentation (if X -> Y, then XZ -> YZ), and Transitivity (if X -> Y and Y -> Z, then X -> Z).

subject: DBMS
question_en: Compare Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) with Pessimistic Locking (2PL).
question_hi: ऑप्टिममिस्टिक कॉन्करेंसी कंट्रोल (OCC) की निराशावादी लॉकिंग (2PL) से तुलना करें।
gold_answer: 2PL locks resources ahead of access, causing lock contention and deadlocks; OCC allows unrestricted reads/writes in local memory, validating for conflicts only at commit time.

subject: DBMS
question_en: How does Multi-Version Concurrency Control (MVCC) eliminate read-write lock contention?
question_hi: मल्टी-वर्जन कॉन्करेंसी कंट्रोल (MVCC) रीड-राइट लॉक विवाद को कैसे समाप्त करता है?
gold_answer: MVCC maintains multiple timestamped versions of each row so readers read a snapshot of older consistent data without blocking concurrent writers who create a newer version.

subject: DBMS
question_en: What is the Dirty Read anomaly and at what SQL isolation level is it permitted?
question_hi: डर्टी रीड विसंगति (Dirty Read anomaly) क्या है और इसे किस SQL अलगाव स्तर पर अनुमति दी जाती है?
gold_answer: A dirty read occurs when a transaction reads uncommitted data modified by another transaction that later aborts; it is permitted only under Read Uncommitted.
notes: Dirty read anomaly under Read Uncommitted

subject: DBMS
question_en: Given relation R(A, B, C, D) with FDs AB -> C, C -> D, and D -> A, determine the candidate keys step-by-step.
question_hi: दिए गए संबंध R(A, B, C, D) और कार्यात्मक निर्भरताओं AB -> C, C -> D, D -> A के साथ, चरणबद्ध तरीके से उम्मीदवार कुंजियों (Candidate Keys) का निर्धारण करें।
gold_answer: Attribute B never appears on the right side, so every candidate key must contain B. (AB)+ = {A,B,C,D}. (BC)+ = {B,C,D,A}. (BD)+ = {B,D,A,C}. Candidate keys are AB, BC, and BD.

subject: DBMS
question_en: Compare Hash Join with Nested Loop Join and Sort-Merge Join in relational query execution.
question_hi: रिलेशनल क्वेरी निष्पादन में हैश जॉइन, नेस्टेड लूप जॉइन और सॉर्ट-मर्ज जॉइन की तुलना करें।
gold_answer: Nested loop join is efficient for small inner tables or indexed lookups; Sort-Merge join excels on pre-sorted data or large equality joins; Hash join builds an in-memory hash table for large equi-joins.

subject: DBMS
question_en: What is the CAP Theorem and what trade-offs does it impose on distributed database systems?
question_hi: CAP प्रमेय क्या है और यह वितरित डेटाबेस सिस्टम पर क्या समझौते लागू करता है?
gold_answer: A distributed system can guarantee at most two of: Consistency, Availability, and Partition Tolerance. When network partitions occur, one must choose between Consistency or Availability.

subject: DBMS
question_en: How does the Two-Phase Commit (2PC) protocol ensure atomic commits across distributed database shards?
question_hi: टू-फेज कमिट (2PC) प्रोटोकॉल वितरित डेटाबेस शार्ड्स पर परमाणु कमिट कैसे सुनिश्चित करता है?
gold_answer: Phase 1 (Prepare): Coordinator sends PREPARE; participants reply VOTE_COMMIT or VOTE_ABORT. Phase 2 (Commit): If all voted commit, coordinator sends GLOBAL_COMMIT; otherwise GLOBAL_ABORT.

subject: DBMS
question_en: Why can 3NF decomposition always guarantee dependency preservation whereas BCNF decomposition cannot?
question_hi: 3NF अपघटन (decomposition) हमेशा निर्भरता संरक्षण की गारंटी क्यों दे सकता है जबकि BCNF अपघटन नहीं कर सकता?
gold_answer: 3NF allows dependencies of the form X -> A where A is a prime attribute (part of a candidate key), whereas BCNF strictly forbids non-superkey determinants even if they preserve functional dependencies.

subject: DBMS
question_en: Explain how query optimization uses cost-based estimation and catalog statistics.
question_hi: बताइए कि क्वेरी अनुकूलन (Query Optimization) लागत-आधारित अनुमान और कैटलॉग आंकड़ों का उपयोग कैसे करता है।
gold_answer: The optimizer generates candidate logical plans, translates them to physical operators, and uses statistics (table cardinality, histograms, index heights) to estimate I/O and CPU costs for minimum total cost.

subject: DBMS
question_en: Compare Relational Databases with Document-oriented NoSQL databases in schema rigidity and horizontal scaling.
question_hi: स्कीमा कठोरता और क्षैतिज स्केलिंग (horizontal scaling) में रिलेशनल डेटाबेस की दस्तावेज़-उन्मुख NoSQL डेटाबेस से तुलना करें।
gold_answer: RDBMS enforces strict relational schemas and joins, scaling predominantly vertically; Document NoSQL uses flexible JSON schemas, sharding easily across commodity clusters without complex foreign-key joins.

subject: DBMS
question_en: How do database buffer pools interact with operating system page caches during dirty page flushes?
question_hi: डर्टी पेज फ्लश के दौरान डेटाबेस बफर पूल ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम पेज कैश के साथ कैसे इंटरैक्ट करते हैं?
gold_answer: DBMS buffer managers often bypass OS page caches using direct I/O (O_DIRECT) to prevent double buffering, redundant paging, and to retain precise control over write-ahead log ordering.
notes: Cross-discipline DBMS and OS buffer cache interaction

subject: DBMS
question_en: What is the exact SQL syntax for creating a zero-latency quantum-entangled distributed table across solar systems?
question_hi: सौर प्रणालियों में शून्य-विलंबता क्वांटम-एंटैंगल वितरित तालिका बनाने के लिए सटीक SQL सिंटैक्स क्या है?
gold_answer: Unanswerable from reference corpus: Faster-than-light quantum distributed tables violate standard physics and do not exist in relational DBMS engines.

subject: DBMS
question_en: How does PostgreSQL 16 store multi-dimensional tensor matrices inside classical B+ trees without vector extensions?
question_hi: PostgreSQL 16 बिना वेक्टर एक्सटेंशन के क्लासिकल B+ ट्री के अंदर मल्टी-डायमेंशनल टेंसर मैट्रिक्स को कैसे संग्रहीत करता है?
gold_answer: Unanswerable from reference corpus: Standard B+ trees index single-dimensional scalar values; multi-dimensional vector search requires specialized indexing like pgvector with HNSW.
notes: Unanswerable: B+ trees cannot index raw tensor matrices

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: What are Coffman's four necessary conditions for deadlock?
question_hi: डेडलॉक की चार आवश्यक कॉफमैन शर्तें (Coffman's conditions) क्या हैं?
gold_answer: Mutual Exclusion, Hold and Wait, No Preemption, and Circular Wait.

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: What is Belady's Anomaly in page replacement?
question_hi: पेज रिप्लेसमेंट में बेलाडी की विसंगति (Belady's Anomaly) क्या है?
gold_answer: The phenomenon where increasing the number of page frames results in an increased number of page faults under FIFO.

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: What three requirements must a solution to the critical-section problem satisfy?
question_hi: क्रिटिकल सेक्शन समस्या के समाधान को किन तीन आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करना चाहिए?
gold_answer: Mutual Exclusion, Progress, and Bounded Waiting.

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: Compare user-level threads (ULT) with kernel-level threads (KLT) in scheduling and syscall overhead.
question_hi: शेड्यूलिंग और सिस्टम कॉल ओवरहेड में यूजर-लेवल थ्रेड्स (ULT) और कर्नेल-लेवल थ्रेड्स (KLT) की तुलना करें।
gold_answer: ULT switching occurs purely in user space without kernel mode transition; however, a blocking system call in ULT blocks the entire process. KLT allows true multi-core concurrency but incurs context switch overhead.

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: Explain how Peterson's Algorithm provides mutual exclusion for two processes.
question_hi: बताइए कि पीटरसन का एल्गोरिदम दो प्रक्रियाओं के लिए पारस्परिक अपवर्जन (Mutual Exclusion) कैसे प्रदान करता है।
gold_answer: It shares a flag array indicating intent and a turn variable; a process enters critical section only when other process is not interested or has yielded turn, guaranteeing mutual exclusion and progress.

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: Explain the Banker's Algorithm data structures and safety check for deadlock avoidance.
question_hi: डेडलॉक से बचाव के लिए बैंकर के एल्गोरिदम के डेटा स्ट्रक्चर और सुरक्षा जांच (Safety Check) समझाइए।
gold_answer: Using Available, Max, Allocation, and Need (Max - Allocation) matrices, it tests whether there exists a safe execution sequence where every process can satisfy its maximum needs with currently available resources.

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: Compare Paging and Segmentation in virtual memory management regarding fragmentation.
question_hi: फ्रेग्मेंटेशन के संबंध में वर्चुअल मेमोरी प्रबंधन में पेजिंग और सेगमेंटेशन की तुलना करें।
gold_answer: Paging uses fixed-size memory blocks, eliminating external fragmentation but suffering from internal fragmentation; Segmentation uses variable-sized logical segments, suffering from external fragmentation.

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: What is the Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB) and how does it reduce effective memory access time?
question_hi: ट्रांसलेशन लुकअसाइड बफर (TLB) क्या है और यह प्रभावी मेमोरी एक्सेस समय को कैसे कम करता है?
gold_answer: A hardware cache in the MMU that stores recent virtual-to-physical page frame translations; a TLB hit eliminates the multi-level page table memory lookups.

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: Trace the step-by-step sequence of events that occurs when a CPU hardware page fault interrupt is triggered.
question_hi: चरणबद्ध तरीके से घटनाओं के उस क्रम को बताएं जो सीपीयू हार्डवेयर पेज फॉल्ट इंटरप्ट ट्रिगर होने पर घटित होता है।
gold_answer: 1. MMU traps to OS. 2. CPU saves registers. 3. OS checks page validity. 4. Allocates free frame. 5. Initiates disk read. 6. Updates page table. 7. Restarts faulting instruction.

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: Compare Shortest Job First (SJF) scheduling with Round Robin (RR) in turnaround time and responsiveness.
question_hi: टर्नअराउंड समय और प्रतिक्रियाशीलता में शॉर्टेस्ट जॉब फर्स्ट (SJF) और राउंड रॉबिन (RR) शेड्यूलिंग की तुलना करें।
gold_answer: SJF provably minimizes average turnaround time but can starve long jobs; Round Robin provides fair time-sliced CPU access, optimizing interactive responsiveness.
notes: SJF vs RR turnaround and response comparison

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: What is thrashing in operating systems and what causes it?
question_hi: ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम में थ्रैशिंग (Thrashing) क्या है और इसका क्या कारण है?
gold_answer: Thrashing is a state where the CPU spends more time swapping pages in and out than executing useful instructions, caused when sum of process working sets exceeds total physical RAM.
notes: Thrashing definition and working set model

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: How does the Clock (Second-Chance) page replacement algorithm approximate LRU?
question_hi: क्लॉक (सेकंड-चांस) पेज रिप्लेसमेंट एल्गोरिदम LRU का सन्निकटन (approximate) कैसे करता है?
gold_answer: It maintains a circular pointer across frames with a reference bit; if reference bit is 1, it resets it to 0 and advances; if 0, that frame is selected for eviction.

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: What is the difference between monolithic kernels and microkernels?
question_hi: मोनोलिथिक कर्नेल (Monolithic Kernel) और माइक्रोकर्नल (Microkernel) के बीच क्या अंतर है?
gold_answer: Monolithic kernels run all OS services (VFS, IPC, drivers, network) in kernel space for speed; microkernels keep only minimal IPC, scheduling, and memory in kernel space, moving services to user-space servers for stability.

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: Compare counting semaphores with binary semaphores (mutexes).
question_hi: काउंटिंग सेमाफोर और बाइनरी सेमाफोर (म्यूटेक्स) की तुलना करें।
gold_answer: A binary semaphore has values 0 or 1, primarily used for mutual exclusion; a counting semaphore takes non-negative integers to manage finite pools of multiple identical resource instances.

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: Explain how priority inversion occurs and how priority inheritance protocol solves it.
question_hi: बताइए कि प्राथमिकता व्युत्क्रमण (Priority Inversion) कैसे होता है और प्राथमिकता विरासत प्रोटोकॉल (Priority Inheritance) इसे कैसे हल करता है।
gold_answer: Priority inversion happens when a low-priority thread holding a shared lock is preempted by a medium-priority thread, starving a waiting high-priority thread. Priority inheritance temporarily elevates the low thread's priority to match the high thread until the lock is released.

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: How does the fork() and exec() sequence create and replace a child process in UNIX systems?
question_hi: UNIX सिस्टम में fork() और exec() का क्रम कैसे एक चाइल्ड प्रोसेस बनाता है और उसे बदलता है?
gold_answer: fork() clones the calling process via copy-on-write, returning 0 to child and child PID to parent; exec() then overwrites the child's address space with a new executable binary.

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: What is an Inode in UNIX file systems and what metadata does it store?
question_hi: UNIX फ़ाइल सिस्टम में Inode क्या है और यह कौन सा मेटाडेटा संग्रहीत करता है?
gold_answer: An index node data structure storing file metadata: file type, permissions, owner, file size, timestamps, and direct/indirect block pointers to disk data blocks.

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: Compare Polling and Interrupt-Driven I/O in CPU efficiency.
question_hi: सीपीयू दक्षता में पोलिंग और इंटरप्ट-चालित I/O की तुलना करें।
gold_answer: Polling wastes CPU cycles in busy-wait loops repeatedly checking device readiness; interrupt-driven I/O allows the CPU to execute other tasks until the hardware device raises an interrupt signal.

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: How does Copy-on-Write (COW) optimize process creation during fork()?
question_hi: कॉपी-ऑन-राइट (COW) fork() के दौरान प्रोसेस निर्माण को कैसे अनुकूलित करता है?
gold_answer: Instead of duplicating the entire address space, parent and child share physical pages marked read-only; physical copy of a page occurs only when either process attempts to write to it.

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: Describe the Producer-Consumer problem and its synchronization solution using semaphores.
question_hi: निर्माता-उपभोक्ता (Producer-Consumer) समस्या और सेमाफोर का उपयोग करके इसके सिंक्रोनाइज़ेशन समाधान का वर्णन करें।
gold_answer: Using three semaphores: mutex (binary, 1) for buffer mutual exclusion, empty (counting, N) for available buffer slots, and full (counting, 0) for filled buffer items to prevent overflow and underflow.

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: Compare Hard Real-Time Systems with Soft Real-Time Systems in deadline guarantees.
question_hi: डेडलाइन गारंटी में हार्ड रियल-टाइम सिस्टम और सॉफ्ट रियल-टाइम सिस्टम की तुलना करें।
gold_answer: Hard real-time systems consider missing a single deadline a total system failure (e.g., flight avionics); soft real-time systems tolerate occasional deadline misses with degraded quality of service (e.g., video streaming).

subject: Operating Systems
question_en: How do operating system socket buffers interact with TCP transport layer window sizing?
question_hi: ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम सॉकेट बफ़र टीसीपी ट्रांसपोर्ट लेयर विंडो साइज़िंग के साथ कैसे इंटरैक्ट करते हैं?
gold_answer: The OS allocates socket receive buffers (SO_RCVBUF); the unused space in this buffer directly dictates the TCP advertised receive window (rwnd) sent in headers to prevent receiver buffer overflow.
notes: Cross-discipline OS socket buffer and TCP rwnd linkage

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: What are the three steps in the TCP 3-Way Handshake?
question_hi: टीसीपी 3-वे हैंडशेक (TCP 3-Way Handshake) के तीन चरण क्या हैं?
gold_answer: 1. SYN (Client to Server), 2. SYN-ACK (Server to Client), 3. ACK (Client to Server).

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: What is the fundamental difference between Flow Control and Congestion Control in TCP?
question_hi: टीसीपी में फ्लो कंट्रोल (Flow Control) और कंजेशन कंट्रोल (Congestion Control) के बीच मूलभूत अंतर क्या है?
gold_answer: Flow control prevents a fast sender from overwhelming a slow receiver (rwnd), while congestion control prevents senders from overwhelming the network subnet (cwnd).

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: How many layers are in the OSI model versus the TCP/IP model?
question_hi: ओएसआई मॉडल में टीसीपी/आईपी मॉडल की तुलना में कितनी परतें होती हैं?
gold_answer: OSI has 7 layers, whereas TCP/IP has 4 layers.

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: Describe the four congestion control phases of TCP Reno: Slow Start, Congestion Avoidance, Fast Retransmit, and Fast Recovery.
question_hi: टीसीपी रेनो (TCP Reno) के चार कंजेशन कंट्रोल चरणों का वर्णन करें: स्लो स्टार्ट, कंजेशन अवॉइडेंस, फास्ट रिट्रांसमिट और फास्ट रिकवरी।
gold_answer: Slow start doubles cwnd per RTT up to ssthresh; congestion avoidance increases cwnd linearly (+1 MSS/RTT); fast retransmit resends on 3 duplicate ACKs; fast recovery halves cwnd and avoids falling back to 1 MSS.

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: Compare TCP and UDP in reliability, header size, and transmission latency.
question_hi: विश्वसनीयता, हेडर आकार और ट्रांसमिशन विलंबता में टीसीपी और यूडीपी की तुलना करें।
gold_answer: TCP is connection-oriented, reliable, orders packets, with a 20-60 byte header and higher latency; UDP is connectionless, unreliable, has an 8-byte header and low latency ideal for real-time media.

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: What is the role of ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) and at what network boundary does it operate?
question_hi: ARP (एड्रेस रेजोल्यूशन प्रोटोकॉल) की क्या भूमिका है और यह किस नेटवर्क सीमा पर काम करता है?
gold_answer: ARP maps a known logical IPv4 address to a physical 48-bit MAC address on a local broadcast domain, operating between Network Layer (Layer 3) and Data Link Layer (Layer 2).

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: Trace how a DNS lookup resolves 'www.example.com' starting from the root nameserver.
question_hi: रूट नेमसर्वर से शुरू करके 'www.example.com' को हल करने वाले DNS लुकअप के चरणों को बताएं।
gold_answer: Client asks local recursive resolver -> Root server directs to .com TLD server -> TLD server directs to authoritative nameserver for example.com -> Authoritative server returns A/AAAA record to resolver and client.

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: Compare Link-State routing (OSPF) with Distance-Vector routing (RIP) in convergence speed and protocol overhead.
question_hi: कन्वर्जेंस गति और प्रोटोकॉल ओवरहेड में लिंक-स्टेट रूटिंग (OSPF) की डिस्टेंस-वेक्टर रूटिंग (RIP) से तुलना करें।
gold_answer: OSPF floods link states and calculates shortest paths using Dijkstra, converging quickly with moderate memory overhead; RIP shares periodic distance vectors with neighbors, converging slowly and prone to count-to-infinity.

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: What is the BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) and what type of routing does it perform across Autonomous Systems?
question_hi: BGP (बॉर्डर गेटवे प्रोटोकॉल) क्या है और यह ऑटोनॉमस सिस्टम (AS) के बीच किस प्रकार की रूटिंग करता है?
gold_answer: BGP is a Path-Vector exterior gateway protocol used for routing between independent Autonomous Systems (AS) across the global Internet.

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: How does Network Address Translation (NAT) allow multiple private IP hosts to share a single public IPv4 address?
question_hi: नेटवर्क एड्रेस ट्रांसलेशन (NAT) कई निजी IP होस्ट को एक ही सार्वजनिक IPv4 एड्रेस साझा करने की अनुमति कैसे देता है?
gold_answer: NAT/NAPT modifies packet IP headers and TCP/UDP port numbers, maintaining a stateful translation table mapping internal private IP:port pairs to public IP:port pairs.

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: Explain why the TIME_WAIT state exists in the TCP connection teardown state machine and why it lasts 2*MSL.
question_hi: समझाइए कि टीसीपी कनेक्शन टियरडाउन स्टेट मशीन में TIME_WAIT अवस्था क्यों मौजूद है और यह 2*MSL तक क्यों रहती है।
gold_answer: It ensures the final ACK is acknowledged by retransmitting if lost, preventing duplicate delayed segments from a closed connection from corrupting a new reincarnation of the same socket pair.

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: Describe how the CSMA/CD protocol detects collisions and executes binary exponential backoff on Ethernet.
question_hi: वर्णन करें कि CSMA/CD प्रोटोकॉल टकरावों का पता कैसे लगाता है और ईथरनेट पर बाइनरी एक्सपोनेंशियल बैकऑफ़ को कैसे निष्पादित करता है।
gold_answer: Transmitting station listens to voltage levels; on collision, it broadcasts a 32-bit jam signal and waits a random backoff time k * 51.2 microseconds where k is chosen from [0, 2^i - 1].

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: Compare IPv4 and IPv6 in address space, header structure, and fragmentation responsibilities.
question_hi: एड्रेस स्पेस, हेडर स्ट्रक्चर और फ्रैग्मेंटेशन जिम्मेदारियों में IPv4 और IPv6 की तुलना करें।
gold_answer: IPv4 uses 32-bit addresses and allows intermediate router fragmentation; IPv6 uses 128-bit addresses, has a streamlined fixed 40-byte base header, and delegates fragmentation strictly to the sending source host.

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: What is the count-to-infinity problem in Distance-Vector routing and how do split horizon and poison reverse mitigate it?
question_hi: डिस्टेंस-वेक्टर रूटिंग में काउंट-टू-इन्फिनिटी समस्या क्या है और स्प्लिट होराइजन व पॉइज़न रिवर्स इसे कैसे कम करते हैं?
gold_answer: Rerouting loops cause metric counts to increment infinitely when a link fails; split horizon stops a router from advertising a route back out the interface it learned it from; poison reverse advertises cost infinity.
notes: Count to infinity and split horizon

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: Explain how the TLS 1.3 cryptographic handshake establishes a secure session in 1-RTT.
question_hi: समझाइए कि TLS 1.3 क्रिप्टोग्राफ़िक हैंडशेक 1-RTT में एक सुरक्षित सत्र कैसे स्थापित करता है।
gold_answer: Client sends ClientHello with supported ciphers and speculative Diffie-Hellman KeyShare; Server responds with ServerHello and its KeyShare, certificate, and finished message, encrypting data on turn 1.

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: Compare HTTP/1.1 pipelining with HTTP/2 binary framing and multiplexing.
question_hi: HTTP/1.1 पाइपलाइनिंग की HTTP/2 बाइनरी फ्रेमिंग और मल्टीप्लेक्सिंग से तुलना करें।
gold_answer: HTTP/1.1 sends text requests sequentially, suffering from Head-of-Line (HoL) blocking; HTTP/2 splits streams into binary frames interleaved over a single TCP connection, eliminating application-level HoL blocking.

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: What is the Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) and Maximum Segment Size (MSS) in Ethernet networks?
question_hi: ईथरनेट नेटवर्क में अधिकतम ट्रांसमिशन यूनिट (MTU) और अधिकतम सेगमेंट आकार (MSS) क्या है?
gold_answer: MTU is the largest packet payload accepted by the physical link layer (typically 1500 bytes on Ethernet); MSS is the largest TCP data payload (MTU - 20 byte IP - 20 byte TCP = 1460 bytes).

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: What is the purpose of the Subnet Mask and CIDR (Classless Inter-Domain Routing) notation?
question_hi: सबनेट मास्क और CIDR नोटेशन का उद्देश्य क्या है?
gold_answer: A subnet mask separates the network prefix from the host identifier in an IP address; CIDR uses a variable-length prefix (/N) allowing flexible routing table aggregation and slowing IPv4 depletion.

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: How does the Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) prevent bridge loops in Layer 2 switched networks?
question_hi: स्पैनिंग ट्री प्रोटोकॉल (STP) लेयर 2 स्विच किए गए नेटवर्क में ब्रिज लूप को कैसे रोकता है?
gold_answer: Switches elect a Root Bridge by lowest Bridge ID, compute shortest paths to the root, and place redundant backup ports into a BLOCKING state, eliminating broadcast storms.
notes: STP loop prevention and port states

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: Compare Selective Repeat ARQ with Go-Back-N ARQ in buffer requirements and transmission efficiency on lossy channels.
question_hi: बफर आवश्यकताओं और ट्रांसमिशन दक्षता में सेलेक्टिव रिपीट ARQ की गो-बैक-N ARQ से तुलना करें।
gold_answer: Go-Back-N requires only 1 buffer at the receiver but retransmits all frames from the lost frame onward; Selective Repeat buffers out-of-order frames at the receiver and retransmits solely the specific damaged frame.

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: Explain how traceroute utilizes ICMP Time Exceeded (Type 11) messages with incrementing TTL values to map network routers.
question_hi: समझाइए कि traceroute नेटवर्क राउटरों को मैप करने के लिए बढ़ते हुए TTL मानों के साथ ICMP टाइम एक्सीडेड (टाइप 11) संदेशों का उपयोग कैसे करता है।
gold_answer: It sends packets starting with TTL=1. The first router decrements TTL to 0, drops the packet, and returns ICMP Time Exceeded containing its IP. Traceroute increments TTL by 1 repeatedly until reaching the destination.

subject: Computer Networks
question_en: How do transport layer TCP connection timeouts interact with operating system process scheduling during heavy CPU loads?
question_hi: भारी सीपीयू लोड के दौरान ट्रांसपोर्ट लेयर टीसीपी कनेक्शन टाइमआउट ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम प्रोसेस शेड्यूलिंग के साथ कैसे इंटरैक्ट करते हैं?
gold_answer: Severe OS scheduling delay causes socket application threads to miss processing incoming TCP ACKs before the Retransmission Timeout (RTO) expires, triggering spurious TCP timeouts and cwnd collapse.
notes: Cross-discipline TCP RTO and OS scheduling starvation
